items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were with Georgie Auld’s small band together for a while in ‘47.

ctx.x: So how did you get involved with Gil and that whole circle of people?
Oh, strangely enough the first person to bring me around, I lived right on the other side of the block of Gil and I didn’t know they were all there and I didn’t know Gil or anything.
